title: ipomoea tenuifolia
intro: Ipomoea tenuifolia, commonly known as Japanese moonseed, is a perennial vine native to East Asia, belonging to the Convolvulaceae family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and anti-diabetic properties, as well as its ability to lower blood pressure and improve cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Ipomoea tenuifolia are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which work to protect against cell damage and oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, such as kaempferol and quercetin, as well as phenolic acids and alkaloids, which have been shown to have anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects.
